summary: Add backward-compatible architecture contract schemas and validation
description: Introduce optional task-local architecture metadata, scoped Architecture Briefs, append-only architecture events, exact decision references, conformance statuses, and time-bounded waivers without invalidating legacy repositories.
acceptance: Legacy tasks and repositories without .go/architecture remain valid.
Task architecture metadata supports none, local, material, and foundational impact with scope, concern, decision, conformance, and human-gate references.
Architecture Brief and append-only event contracts validate accepted, superseded, conformance, deviation, and expiring-waiver states.
verification: uv run --no-project --with pytest --with jsonschema pytest tests/test_architecture.py -q
